workstreams.scope: 会、同会、会照、同拱、借会、相会 and other palace-graph relation phrases.

workstreams.gate_question_zh: 会、同会、会照、同拱、借会、相会是否映射到固定宫位集合，还是必须按星系/上下文逐条解释？

workstreams.scope: Named structures, flanking patterns, three-way conditions and multi-clause source antecedents.
workstreams.safe_precursor: Inventory named/composite structures and dependency graphs only.
workstreams.gate_question_zh: 财荫夹、刑忌夹、府相朝垣、阳梁昌禄等应作为 primitive pattern facts，还是由基础事实实时推导的可审计 macro？

workstreams.scope: Real-world occupation, organizational role, education/credentials, behavior/action and explicitly required external facts.
workstreams.safe_precursor: Define a separate candidate external-input vocabulary; do not infer values from natal chart.
workstreams.gate_question_zh: 哪些现实信息可作为显式 external/context input 进入推演，以及它们与 Natal/Personal State 的接口边界如何固定？

workstreams.scope: 无、不见、不会、无禄、无煞等 explicit-negative semantics.
workstreams.safe_precursor: Inventory negative phrases and identify facts that can be computed from a complete chart snapshot.
workstreams.gate_question_zh: 缺席事实必须由完整命盘显式计算，还是允许 closed-world assumption；未出现事实是否永远不得直接等同不存在？

workstreams.scope: 入庙、落陷 and future dignity/brightness facts.
workstreams.safe_precursor: Inventory source dignity vocabulary and identify required ephemeris/chart-data source.
workstreams.gate_question_zh: 庙旺利陷采用哪一套 canonical 数据源/枚举，并如何处理不同派别表格冲突？

workstreams.scope: 大运/流年、连续窗口、克应期和 path-dependent outcomes.
workstreams.safe_precursor: Classify point trigger vs interval/window vs path dependency without adding activation defaults.
workstreams.gate_question_zh: PL3-T 如何表达连续若干流年、前后路径与克应窗口，并与 Natal Prior、Personal State 分离？

workstreams.safe_precursor: Keep as annotation/methodology inventory; no execution semantics proposed.
